title: Portable record key formatter
goal: Normalize a label, encode it as a portable key and format one deterministic text record.
architecture: Four small pure Python modules. Normalization and encoding are independent; composition consumes both frozen interfaces; record formatting consumes composition.

requirements.text: Normalize labels by stripping surrounding whitespace and applying Unicode casefold; reject empty results.
Percent-encode UTF-8 bytes except ASCII letters, digits, underscore and hyphen; hexadecimal digits are uppercase.
Compose normalization and encoding without duplicating their algorithms.
Format a record as key=<encoded-key> with no newline or additional fields.

decisions.text: Functions are pure. Type errors and empty-label errors propagate; no I/O, global mutation, caching or package installation.

anti_scope: No network, APIs, LLM calls or subprocesses in the sample modules.
Do not modify package configuration, shared plan/state or files outside the task's allowed list.
Workers in a shared workspace do not stage, commit, push, rebase or otherwise mutate Git.

functions.name: normalize_label
contains: Return label.strip().casefold(); raise ValueError if the result is empty.
does_not_contain: No encoding, record formatting, I/O, global mutation or caching.

acceptance.text: Whitespace-only input raises ValueError and non-string input raises TypeError.

functions.name: encode_key
contains: Encode UTF-8 bytes; preserve ASCII A-Z, a-z, 0-9, underscore and hyphen; encode all other bytes as %HH using uppercase hex.
does_not_contain: No normalization, record formatting, network or writes.

acceptance.text: encode_key('A b') returns 'A%20b'; encode_key('é') returns '%C3%A9'; encode_key('a_b-1') is unchanged.

functions.name: build_key
contains: Import normalize_label and encode_key from their declared modules.
Return encode_key(normalize_label(label)); propagate their errors unchanged.
does_not_contain: No duplicate normalization/encoding algorithm, error swallowing, I/O or global mutation.

acceptance.text: build_key('  Ab C  ') returns 'ab%20c'; empty input raises ValueError without masking the exception.

tasks.title: Format the final deterministic text record

functions.name: format_record
contains: Return 'key=' + build_key(label) with no trailing newline; propagate errors.
does_not_contain: No extra fields, serialization framework, logging, I/O or mutable shared state.

acceptance.text: format_record('  Ab C  ') returns exactly 'key=ab%20c', including absence of a newline.
